reviews.author: Ruth Flynn
reviews.text: Although the ramen and food were lovely, the customer service was disappointing, especially from the manager. I’ve visited several times with colleagues and friends, hoping each visit would be better, but unfortunately we have left disappointed every time. The staff were not accommodating to customers’ needs, and the overall service lacked warmth and professionalism. What made the experience even more frustrating was that a service charge was already included in the bill, even though it is optional. This puts customers in an awkward position and makes the dining experience uncomfortable. A service charge should reflect good service, not be assumed. The food is genuinely good, but the consistently poor customer service means I cannot recommend this place until it improves.

reviews.author: Afterlife Addict
reviews.text: I gave Maki & Ramen a second chance, and I instantly regretted it. The food wasn’t even the biggest issue. The customer service, especially from the manager, completely ruined the experience. Instead of listening to our concerns or trying to find a solution, the manager was defensive throughout the conversation. We weren’t expecting anything unreasonable, just some understanding and a willingness to resolve the situation. To make matters worse, we were still charged a mandatory service charge, despite receiving service that was far below expectations. It’s disappointing to be expected to pay extra for an experience that left us feeling ignored. What made this even more frustrating was that we had guests visiting from overseas, and this ended up ruining what should have been an enjoyable evening. Unfortunately, after giving this restaurant another chance, I won’t be returning. If you’re looking for ramen in Glasgow, I’d recommend trying Ramen Dayo instead. The difference in customer service and overall experience is night and day.

reviews.author: Lime
reviews.text: Sadly, my experience at Maki & Ramen wasn't the best. I asked for a Tantan ramen without chili oil, and the waiter said he could ask the chef to use less chili oil than usual. I agreed, but what I got was probably the spiciest dish I have ever eaten in my entire life. Not only was there a huge amount of spicy oil, but there were also plenty of chili pepper pieces! The eggs were also simply boiled and not like the classic ramen eggs you would expect. My cousin ordered a Chicken Laksa. The menu described it as *"A Malaysian-inspired twist packed with lemongrass, galangal and garlic. Creamy coconut rounds out this fragrant, warming chicken broth for a bold, exotic experience."* However, there was no chicken in it at all! And of course she paid it the normal price. After leaving half of our ramen in our bowls, we tried several times to get the waiters' attention to explain what had happened. They either pretended not to see us or said, "One minute and I'll come to you," but then never came back. After 16 minutes of waiting, we were fed up and simply asked for the bill — and, surprisingly, we didn't have to wait for that. We will not be returning. We felt completely let down and, frankly, robbed, as we didn't receive what we ordered.

reviews.text: We got in and stood at the door for ages as the service was extremely slow. Even after we sat down, no one came to take our order and we were constantly being ignored. About 20 minutes after ordering, a different guy came over and told us the ramen bowl wasn't available, which was the main reason we came. We ended up having two starters and then left. I'm really dissatisfied. I must say we were given a £20 gift card to come back, and if it had just been about the food, I guess that would have been fine. reviews.author: Marek Marek
reviews.text: The food here is an absolute revelation, every dish was fresh, full of flavor, and prepared with the utmost care. The chefs definitely know what they are doing, and the culinary experience was top-notch. The service in the dining room was also efficient and friendly. Unfortunately, a big minus goes to the venue's policy regarding the service charge. It was automatically added to the bill upfront, and what's worse, no one informed us about it or asked if we agreed to it. Furthermore, the staff also failed to inform us that this fee could be opted out of entirely. I would have left a tip anyway because the food and the work of the waiters were worth it, but imposing a service fee in this manner is simply in bad taste and ruins a good impression. It's a shame that such a minor yet unfair practice hurts the image of the entire place. Despite everything, it's worth coming here just for the taste, but the staff should be more transparent with their customers.

reviews.author: Bridget Blasdell
reviews.text: This place was ok. The menus could have done with a wipe down. They were sticky. They are also big and bulky, especially the drinks menu. We were a table of us and wished to sit outside due to the lovely weather. The host was unsure as "the tables can't be moved" and made up for 2 or 4. We suggested to split and sit as a 2 and 3, not ideal as we are 2 adults and 3 children. We ended up with a chair at the end of our table but it blocked access to the table next to us. It was suggested we use the QR to order or pay upfront with the server. We opted to order via the QR, however you you can't order the kids bento on there. So we ended up doing that with the server. All a big fluff to be honest. Sorry we removed the pre added service charge when ordering because why pay service upfront? The staff were nice but this cost them a tip, as we didn't have cash to leave one. Food was ok, half of us enjoyed it and half didn't. We all the same fried chicken but in different dishes. The deco' is lovely but could have done without the faux blossom flowers on the outside as they block the view of the lake. Those little things could make this place great. We will try again some time.

reviews.text: Ambience is good and was nice. Not sure why the reviews are all 5 stars. My Tom yum soup had two prawns and two pieces of shrimp, one egg and soup was watery. The maki roll was alright as well. We also waited to the end of our main meal for tap water to arrive. Wouldn't rush back sadly. Had high hopes.

reviews.author: C P
reviews.text: Genuinely the most disappointing meal I've had. I came for my 50th birthday based on an Instagram video and it couldn't have been more different. We were sat in an area that looked like it was the holding area for people who had ordered takeaway, the bar was covered in dirty glasses, my blue bubble margarita don't come with a bubble, the food was under seasoned and underwhelming, and the edamame had bits of other food in there. To top it off, the toilets were like a horror film...so stinking and dirty! They took the cost of some things off the bill but honestly we would never come back ☹️

reviews.author: Kim Marsden
reviews.text: An absolutely superb experience!! My first sushi restaurant and it was simply amazing!! Except I was the only one using a fork😳 a beautiful vibe and great music .. 10 out of 10

reviews.author: Sena Balikci
reviews.text: Food is amazing, but service was honestly not very good. They were too slow and almost avoiding eye contact with us when trying to order. The astmosphere is the worst, it’s already so loud with a lot of people packed in the restaurant and on top they are playing loud music. It’s very overstimulating

reviews.author: Rishi Kapoor
reviews.text: Exceptional food....best Katsu curry I ever had....customer service was also outstanding....Ginger was an outstanding host....amazing place for authentic Japanese food...sushi & ramen were great....highly recommended 👌

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.text: A wonderful adresse for a far price ! While Google maps struggled to indicate exactly where the entrance was, I'm really glad I found it. Quick service, delicious and cute (small drawing made by costumers are put everywhere).

reviews.author: Bridge Phillips
reviews.text: Firstly, the food looked nothing like the menu. Genuinely the WORST ramen i’ve had in my entire life. I’ve had instant ramen that tasted better and would’ve been much cheaper. I ordered the steak ramen, it has thick juicy steak slices on the menu but came with 4 flimsy pieces that looked like it had been boiled. The half egg was over cooked. SO incredibly overpriced for the quality you’re getting. £15 for that??? in this economy? I would’ve taken a photo but it didn’t deserve to be on my camera roll. I’ve never left a bad review but this takes the cake. Safe to say, I won’t be coming back.

reviews.author: Rajeev Daswani
reviews.text: An amazing experience with lovely Ramen. Loved the chicken karage and the laksa ramen. Amazing service they are very friendly.

reviews.author: Ulfa O
reviews.text: It is a nice place. Have a similar friendly vibe with Edinburgh and Nottingham ones. Steak Tataki ramen was quite nice, spicy and filling. Its also halal. I had extra takoyaki. All quite nice and quick service.

reviews.author: Cat Kostenko
reviews.text: We had such a lovely dinner at Maki & Ramen Old Street! All the food was really good. We started with the pumpkin croquettes and takoyaki, followed by two bowls of ramen, and everything was delicious. We had the house beer, Makibiru, with our dinner and stayed for some cocktails afterwards, which were also super delicious! The restaurant itself is decorated so cool, with a really fun atmosphere, and all of the staff seemed genuinely welcoming and lovely. We were served by Mahak, who was super sweet and absolutely wonderful throughout our visit. She was really patient and helpful with our allergies and dietary requirements, and was attentive throughout the whole evening to make sure we had a great time. We live locally, so we’re really happy to have found another great spot nearby and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Sebastian Ortiz
reviews.text: Everything was great! Lovely staff (shout out to our waitress Mahak) and amazing atmosphere. Food was really good! Definitely worth coming to this restaurant!

reviews.author: Asma Begum
reviews.text: The experience was exquisite. Beautiful deco located in a quiet space. Food was amazing and service was absolutely remarkable.

reviews.author: Shah Qureshi
reviews.text: Mahak showed great service this evening at maki and roll. Great food, great atmosphere. Definitely will visit again.

reviews.author: Xavier Owens
reviews.text: Great food, exceptional service, brilliant atmosphere and comforting lighting. The only piece of feedback would be for more soft drinks on the drinks menu.

reviews.author: jack
reviews.text: The food was incredibly fast and delicious, and the waitress, mahak was very polite accomodating

reviews.author: Martin Deutsch
reviews.text: Great food, really enjoyed everything! Big shoutout to Navin W, our server, he was super friendly, attentive and made the whole experience even better. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Sophie Amaro
reviews.text: Navin W provided amazing customer service and made sure we were attended to always. Amazing food , great atmosphere

reviews.author: Natalie Louise Felton
reviews.text: Unfortunately, we left feeling quite disappointed with our experience at Maki and ramen, particularly as we had chosen to come here to celebrate our anniversary and were looking forward to it. We were seated in what felt like a tucked-away corner and unfortunately seemed to be forgotten about. It took around 25 minutes for anyone to come over and serve us, despite approximately 5 members of staff walking past us during that time. Unfortunately, the service didn’t improve after that. It then took a further 30 minutes for us to receive our drinks, and we had to remind the staff twice that we had actually ordered them even getting our food before our drinks... We completely understand that restaurants can get busy, especially as this is new to west Quay but it was difficult to understand how our table could be overlooked for so long when there were so many staff members walking passed us. To make matters worse, when we eventually asked for the bill, we felt like we were suddenly being hovered over by staff, which made the experience feel even more uncomfortable. It was a very different level of attention compared with when we were waiting to be served. We had been looking forward to having a nice day together. Unfortunately, feeling like we had been shoved into a corner and forgotten about for such a significant part of the meal really put a dampener on what was supposed to be a special occasion. Hopefully this was just an off day, but based on our experience, the service really needs some attention. We expected a much more attentive and welcoming experience, especially when celebrating something special. I wouldn’t rush back here.

reviews.author: Flo Blatchford
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! A must go to in Southampton! Super friendly staff, funky atmosphere and food is delicious! Highly recommend the chicken yaki soba, chicken karage (was a top tier recommendation from our waitress) and the salmon and avocado sushi rolls. Drinks were genuinely some of the best I’ve had! Best mocktail I’ve had anywhere! I ordered the volcano, sweet but not too sweet and very refreshing. House beer is also a must! The watermelon prebiotic soda might be my new favourite soft drink. TOO many good choices!!! Will definitely be my new go to place! And I will be back for the ramen, looked fab!!

reviews.author: Ali Abou El Hassan
reviews.text: Great atmosphere, delicious food and well worth the visit! Ordered the chicken yakisoba, gyozas, chicken karage and sushi. Enjoyed the house beer and cocktails.

reviews.author: rose dabo
reviews.text: I came here for dinner with my partner and honestly, we absolutely loved this place! The manager, Jada, took such great care of us and made some great recommendations. She’s such a lovely person, and we loved her vibe! The whole experience was amazing, and we’ll definitely be back soon.

reviews.author: Christina N
reviews.text: Amazing experience from the friendly staff and incredible food. The highlights of the dinner were definitely the hand rolls, and our chef Victoria who was attentive and a pleasure to meet. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bjorn Van Reet
reviews.text: Very nice and clean place to have some good food. Service is slow, but the food is delicious. Only attention point is the price compared to the proportion you get. Is not cheap, and you could be disappointed if you are looking for a good sushi place. Nothing to do with kids.

reviews.author: Kleyra Funes
reviews.text: I was delighted with the food at this place, but the best part was the service that Kayleigh provided to us. She was very kind and polite. I will definitely return.

reviews.author: Sian Blake
reviews.text: Had such a lovely experience here! The sushi was absolutely delicious — fresh, beautifully presented and full of flavour. There was a great selection and everything we ordered was excellent. A special mention to Kayleigh, our waitress, who was fantastic. She was so friendly, attentive and helpful throughout the meal, and really made the experience feel special. She couldn’t have been more welcoming.

reviews.author: Mack Ald
reviews.text: Omg 🤗 the food it’s amazing fresh and tasty The service was the best Tks Kayleigh the best 🫶🏼

reviews.text: The food and the ambience both were really nice. The manager, i believe, kelly, was very friendly from the beginning. Ruby and Viktoria both took great care talking and serving great food. The furikake, which they make in-house was really nice as well. Also, shoutout to Jayda for being so friendly.

reviews.author: Kate Dianova
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place, easily one of the best Japanese restaurants around. Everything was fresh and delicious, the service was super quick, and we couldn’t believe how reasonable the bill was. Great food, great service 🫶

reviews.text: Amazing place, amazing flavours! Price and portions were also great considering the high quality materials.

reviews.author: Ryan Liew
reviews.text: good, but not the pristine omakase service I’m used to in higher end japanese places. food is good but service is a little haphazard a lot of the plates and cutlery were quite dirty, smudged with random pieces of fish/ginger - this includes the seats that were quite crumby; when waiter served my prawn tempura he spilled the sauce on the table and on me; toilets were quite filthy… overall the food was nice but certain elements can be improved :)

reviews.text: Fish is not fresh and not cheap. The cook dropped a big piece of fish out of the roll before serving and still served to me like nothing happened. The waitress has no idea what’s chef’s recommendation on menu and act impatient. The WORST experience I’ve ever had in a sushi place

reviews.text: Looking for Sushi like in Tokyo - here’s the right place! Exceptional quality, marvellous staff and a very passionate chef de cuisine.
